name: Undecided caller becomes a captured lead
looks: A second call card for a different, more open-ended question sits beside an intake panel. Its fields fill in one at a time, straight from the call, name first, then address, then a short note on what the caller needs, each field typing on under its own label as the panel's answered-count ticks up.
build: terminal-type-on drives each field's reveal, one after another rather than all at once, each completing before the next field starts; the panel's 'x of y answers' counter updates live with the field count, no separate easing.
sound: A light key tick under each field, a soft confirm blip as the answered-count advances.
prompt: Show a product rescuing an unready visitor: a loosely worded question becomes a structured intake record as its fields fill in live, one at a time, straight from the conversation, with a small counter proving nothing was missed.
